question: What was Cisco's fiscal 2026 total revenue growth YoY and its GAAP net margin (net income / revenue)?
grading: Growth ±0.2pp; net margin ±0.2pp; inputs must be FY ended 2026-07-25 and FY ended 2025-07-26
answer: Cisco FY2026 revenue growth was 11.7750% YoY. GAAP net margin was 20.9507%: USD 13,267 million GAAP net income / USD 63,325 million revenue. FY2025 revenue was USD 56,654 million. [G05-E1]
